issues.title: Renaming a Branch target invalidates its retained creation membership
issues.classification: functional / safety recovery / global command-stack corruption
issues.regression: independently corroborates the cross-world Rename/Branch stack defect
issues.expected: Renaming a Context created by Branch preserves a reconstructible producer unit under the new canonical name, so later Undo/Redo can verify and restore it.
issues.actual: Rename M1 changed `.../b1` to `.../renamed-1`, but its Branch receipt retained target membership `.../b1`. The read-only stack builder then failed with `Branch checkpoint owner is outside its creation membership` after Branch M2. Counted inverse Rename M2 restored `.../b1`; the exact 11-member B2 unit then rebuilt and Undo2/Redo2 both succeeded.
issues.workaround: Do not Rename a Branch/checkout-created Context while its creation checkpoint is retained. If no descendant has copied the invalid history, restore the exact original target name before using the global stack.
issues.reproduction: One successful Branch-target Rename, one deterministic host stack failure, then one exact inverse-name recovery followed by successful Undo/Redo.

issues.title: Branch-of-Branch copies historical creation receipts as invalid target history
issues.classification: functional / safety recovery / inherited command-history corruption
issues.regression: newly isolated from a clean-source negative control
issues.expected: Branching a live prior Branch target either omits creation-only checkpoints from the copied history or treats them as lineage, leaving the new producer unit and the Profile-global Undo/Redo stack reconstructible.
issues.actual: The clean `guardrails` Source had zero Branch checkpoints. B1 had one valid creation receipt. Branch M3 copied that receipt into B3, where its owner is outside the recorded B1 target membership; Checkout M3 then copied both B1 and B3 receipts into co3. Exact current creation receipts remained identifiable, but every later global stack build and six counted Undo/Redo controls failed closed.
issues.workaround: Use a checkpoint-history-clean ordinary Source for Branch/checkout -b. Once a target has inherited multiple creation-only receipts, there is no non-destructive global Undo workaround; retain the malformed audit state as negative evidence.
issues.reproduction: B1 → B3 → co3 created three invalid owner/creation-membership pairs; 6/6 later counted Undo/Redo calls failed with the same builder error.

limitations.title: Checkout M5 output was lost when the parent harness received SIGINT
limitations.classification: audit harness / operator interruption (not product behavior)
limitations.expected: Capture the missing-target Checkout M5 exit and output once.
limitations.actual: The pinned sequence-89 subprocess had started when SIGINT interrupted the parent communicate() call. It is retained once as exit 130 with unavailable output; exact sequence-88-post/current host digests prove it published no durable change.
limitations.workaround: Do not replay. Preserve exit 130 plus the exact pre/post host digest bridge.
limitations.reproduction: One campaign-only operator interruption; no product conclusion drawn.

limitations.title: UUID-shaped Study name was a valid high-cost input, not a safe negative control
limitations.classification: audit input assumption / high-cost identity escape
limitations.regression: new audit protocol failure; current Profile grammar permits this name
limitations.expected: Per the ADMIN protocol, init-study M5 rejects the chosen name before creating or activating any Profile, leaving success count zero and identity pinned.
limitations.actual: The UUID-shaped string satisfies the frozen portable Profile-name grammar. Sequence 95 exited 0, created a full managed Study Profile/Store, and selected it. The mandatory host read caught the new UID/root. The new Profile/Store were retained unchanged as evidence; only registry active_uid was atomically restored before seq96.
limitations.workaround: For zero-success audit trials use a syntactically invalid slash name, reserved name, missing baseline, invalid worker count, or an actual TUI cancel. Do not assume a UUID-shaped Study/Profile name is invalid.
limitations.reproduction: One exact non-TTY init-study call; success and identity escape were host-verified.

limitations.title: Context Import M1/M2 used identities already present in the combined Study Store
limitations.classification: audit input assumption / pre-existing identity collision
limitations.expected: Exercise successful direct and recursive by-value Context import into scratch.
limitations.actual: Both imports safely failed because the task-1 Context UIDs already existed under their task-1 canonical names in the active combined Study Store. Memory Import M3 still exercised a successful exact by-value route.
limitations.workaround: Choose a source Profile/Context identity not already present in the active Store.
limitations.reproduction: Two deterministic Context identity collisions and one successful Memory import.

limitations.title: Stack recovery required counted ADMIN route substitutions
limitations.regression: campaign adaptation after a P1 recoverability defect
limitations.expected: Execute the prescribed Rename and Lock targets while preserving five attempts per operation.
limitations.actual: Rename M2 became the counted inverse-name recovery. Later successful Rename trials used Init-created scratch Contexts rather than Branch/Checkout targets, and Lock M4 protected the scratch subtree so the protected Undo boundary remained exercised without creating another Rename owner mismatch. Actual argv/routes are in the ledger.
limitations.workaround: Treat these methods as recovery-adapted evidence, not exact replicas of the original rows.
limitations.reproduction: One bounded same-phase recovery path; no supplemental mem calls or replay.

limitations.title: Init M5 assumed a missing lexical parent must fail without --parents
limitations.classification: audit input assumption / documented exact-leaf behavior
limitations.expected: The ADMIN row expected a missing-parent validation failure.
limitations.actual: Init created only the exact requested nested Context and did not create a parent Context. This matches detailed Init Help: default creates the exact name; --parents additionally creates missing parent Contexts.
limitations.workaround: Use a UID-shaped name or an existing-name collision for a deterministic safe failure.
limitations.reproduction: One exact nested Init without --parents, exit 0.
